sn1.2:1.2: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn1.2:2.1: Jānāsi no tvaṃ mārisa sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan ti || ||
sn1.2:3.1: Jānāmi khvāham āvuso sattānam nimokkham pamokkhaṃ vivekan ti || ||
sn1.2:4.1: Yathā katham pana tvaṃ mārisa jānāsi sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan ti || ||
sn1.2:5.5: sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ || pamokkhaṃ vivekan ti || || Evam antaṃ
